name: Exp_i4_DRF_v2
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Institutional Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when the dynamic range confirms momentum. It uses version 2 of the system with improved entry filtering and trade management logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i4（机构指数）和DRF（动态范围过滤器）指标实现趋势跟踪策略，在动态范围确认动量时沿主导趋势方向开仓。这是该系统的第二版，改进了入场过滤和交易管理逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心结合i4指标判断市场机构资金流向和DRF动态范围过滤器确认趋势方向，两者共振时产生交易信号。入场条件为i4指标显示多空方向且DRF过滤器突破动态范围边界，确认趋势启动后顺势开仓。出场条件包括反向信号出现、固定止损止盈触发或动态跟踪止损平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于账户风险的动态手数计算两种模式。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单笔风险百分比控制，以防止过度集中风险。策略适合中长周期运行，避免短线噪音干扰。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core combines the i4 indicator to gauge institutional money flow direction and the DRF dynamic range filter to confirm trend directionality, generating trade signals when both align. Entry conditions require the i4 indicator showing a bullish or bearish bias while the DRF filter breaks beyond its dynamic range boundary, confirming trend initiation before entering in the trend direction. Exit conditions include opposing signal appearance, fixed stop-loss and take-profit triggers, or dynamic trailing stop closure. Position sizing supports both fixed lot mode and risk-based dynamic lot calculation proportional to account equity. Money management features maximum position limits and per-trade risk percentage controls to prevent over-concentration of exposure. The strategy is suited for medium-to-long timeframe operation, avoiding short-term market noise interference.

pros: 双指标共振过滤减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
支持固定手数和动态风险管理两种仓位模式，灵活适应不同交易需求
设有最大持仓数和风险百分比双重资金保护机制
动态跟踪止损保护已实现利润，避免盈利回吐
版本迭代优化了入场过滤逻辑，信号可靠性优于初版
pros_en: Dual-indicator confluence filtering reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Supports both fixed lot and dynamic risk-based position sizing for flexible trading needs
Dual capital protection via maximum position count and risk percentage controls
Dynamic trailing stop protects realized profits and prevents profitable trades from turning negative
Version 2 iteration improved entry filtering logic, making signals more reliable than the initial version
cons: 双指标系统在震荡市中可能频繁产生错误信号导致连续止损
依赖固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率(ATR)动态调整，在不同品种上适配性差
缺乏隔夜/周末仓位管理和新闻事件过滤机制，面临跳空风险
i4指标为自定义指标，用户需额外安装且可能缺乏充分验证
未明确包含滑点和点差过滤，在高成本交易环境下表现可能受损
cons_en: Dual-indicator system may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop-losses
Fixed pip-based stop-loss and take-profit without ATR-based dynamic adjustment results in poor adaptability across different instruments
Lacks overnight/weekend position management and news event filtering, exposing trades to gap risk
The i4 indicator is custom and requires additional installation with potentially insufficient validation
No explicit slippage and spread filtering, which may degrade performance in high-cost trading environments
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，适应不同品种波动特性
增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在震荡行情中暂停交易避免连续亏损
加入点差过滤和新闻事件时间窗口回避机制，降低交易成本和黑天鹅风险
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to replace fixed pip values, adapting to different instrument volatility characteristics
Add market regime identification module (e.g., ADX or volatility filter) to pause trading during ranging conditions and avoid consecutive losses
Incorporate spread filtering and news event time window avoidance to reduce trading costs and black swan risk exposure

risk_points: 固定点数止损未根据市场波动率动态调整，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
缺乏隔夜跳空和新闻事件保护机制
依赖外部自定义指标i4的可用性和准确性
risk_points_en: Fixed pip stop-loss does not dynamically adjust based on market volatility, being too wide in low-volatility and too tight in high-volatility conditions
No overnight gap or news event protection mechanism
Dependency on external custom i4 indicator availability and accuracy

summary_en: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Institutional Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when the dynamic range confirms momentum. It uses version 2 of the system with improved entry filtering and trade management logic.
